picks.headline: Big drugmakers tell House committee they will halt clinical trials at some hospitals in China
picks.blurb: Five large pharmaceutical companies told Congress they do not plan to open new clinical trial sites in China's Xinjiang region.

picks.headline: Isomorphic Labs enters into a strategic research collaboration with MSD
picks.blurb: The company pairs its AI drug-design engine with the pharmaceutical group's proprietary data and discovery experience to advance therapeutic candidates.

picks.headline: CD19 CAR T cell therapy alters disease-associated immune signatures in multiple sclerosis
picks.blurb: A preliminary series of five patients found expanded CAR T cells and sustained drops in disease biomarkers in cerebrospinal fluid.

picks.headline: Study raises doubts about combining vaccine, monoclonal antibody to protect against malaria
picks.blurb: Researchers found the antibody interfered with a new malaria vaccine when both were given to infants, and plan to prioritize other groups in future studies.

picks.headline: How a tiny chemical mark is placed to double gene activity
picks.blurb: Detailed images of the protein spools that package DNA show how one enzyme adds a precise chemical modification that regulates gene activity.

picks.headline: Actinogen's sole drug fails pivotal Alzheimer's study, sinking stock 80%
picks.blurb: The Australian biotech's lead candidate missed in a late-stage trial, though the company still intends to take the data to the FDA to discuss next steps.

picks.headline: A cardiologist is puzzled by the blockbuster new study on deprescribing statins
picks.blurb: A cardiologist's opinion piece finds a large trial on stopping statins confusing and raises questions about how to read its results.

picks.headline: Peptide market poised to explode with new Hims and Noom launches
picks.blurb: Two consumer health companies are widening access to peptides, a market opening up in a regulatory gray area despite thin scientific evidence.

picks.headline: Meet Shepherd, the meta-agent keeping rogue AI in check
picks.blurb: The tool applies version control and sandboxing so that AI agents can recover from mistakes while a supervising agent manages them.

picks.headline: Programmable functional RNA design with a virtual scientist
picks.blurb: RhoAgent is an agentic system that proposes RNA designs and refines them with experimental feedback, using a diffusion-based model to target three-dimensional structure.

picks.headline: Targeting a cellular "traffic jam" treats multiple diseases in mice
picks.blurb: Researchers describe a strategy that clears cells of the misfolded proteins behind a group of inherited genetic diseases.

picks.headline: Novartis projects slowed growth, pins hopes on billions in pipeline potential
picks.blurb: With Kisqali losing patent protection and prices falling, the company narrowed its sales guidance to about 5% growth, while management says it has a plan to recover.

picks.headline: Conservation of the tumour microenvironment across organs and species
picks.blurb: Screening thousands of public single-cell datasets, researchers found shared host-cell programs across 42 cancer types and released an interactive atlas and software package.

picks.headline: Microbiome home tests are taking off. Can they be trusted?
picks.blurb: A Nature reporter mailed in a stool sample to two companies and compares what each told her about her gut microbiome.

picks.headline: The emerging winners and losers in the AI scribe market
picks.blurb: STAT's AI Prognosis newsletter examines how the AI scribe market is settling, along with news from the HLTH conference.

picks.headline: Hypothalamic volume and cell-type changes in ageing and Alzheimer's disease
picks.blurb: HypoAD pairs MRI from 458 people with single-nucleus RNA sequencing of 614,403 nuclei, reporting that metabolism- and circadian-regulating hypothalamic subregions are particularly vulnerable in ageing and Alzheimer's.

picks.headline: With $173 million, new startup takes aim at sickle cell
picks.blurb: Marrow Therapeutics' founder is pursuing a sickle cell therapy meant to rival gene therapy's effectiveness while avoiding its drawbacks, backed by fresh venture funding.

picks.headline: CTAD 2026: Biogen and AriBio report Alzheimer's therapy wins
picks.blurb: Conference reports describe positive results for two companies' programs while two others fell short; one of those plans an FDA filing based on a subgroup signal.

picks.headline: Merck scraps centerpiece of $2.7B ArQule buy after late-stage safety concerns
picks.blurb: Merck is ending several Phase 3 trials of nemtabrutinib after a benefit-risk review, removing it from the race among non-covalent BTK inhibitors.

picks.headline: Pfizer launches into autoimmune CAR T with China's Starna in up to $2.6B deal
picks.blurb: Under the agreement, Starna will work with Pfizer on three in vivo CAR T candidates aimed at autoimmune indications.
